purpose: Restructure stores; teach 市内/赤字/外部/再度/づくり/お尋ね/ミス/自覚

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 市内の三店舗、統合を検討しています。
lines.en: We are considering merging the three in-city stores.
lines.style: strategic manager presenting a bold plan

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 赤字店をそのままにはできないな。
lines.en: We cannot leave the loss-making stores as is.
lines.style: decisive boss confronting the reality, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 外部の物流に頼りすぎたのも一因です。
lines.en: Over-relying on outside logistics is one cause.
lines.style: analytical manager diagnosing the root issue

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 再度、契約条件を交渉しよう。
lines.en: Let us renegotiate the contract terms again.
lines.style: firm boss directing the next move

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ブランドづくりにも投資したいところです。
lines.en: I would also like to invest in brand-building.
lines.style: forward-looking manager advocating growth, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一点お尋ねするが、在庫管理は改善した？
lines.en: One question — has inventory management improved?
lines.style: pointed boss checking on follow-through, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ミスは減りましたが、まだ甘いです。
lines.en: Mistakes dropped, but it is still lax.
lines.style: honest manager refusing to overstate progress

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 全員が当事者の自覚を持つべきだ。
lines.en: Everyone should hold a sense of ownership.
lines.style: rallying boss demanding shared responsibility, tone holding steady through the whole line
